dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Oho, so you're the ones behind the potion shop I've heard so much about! When it comes to fulfilling requests, I heard the customer's wish is practically your command.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Gorou? Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and Kirara's here too! What are you guys doing in Mondstadt?

choices.text: Didn't expect to see you here!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, the Komaniya Express operates all across Teyvat, so I'm always on the road.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: I'm actually pretty familiar with Mondstadt from my trips here in the past. General Gorou, on the other hand... seems to still be getting the lay of the land... He got lost not too far from here...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: *ahem* Well, I would normally be provided with ample intel before carrying out an operation in a foreign territory... But, Watatsumi Island isn't exactly home to many people who've been to Mondstadt. I wasn't even able to obtain a map of the region.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I've basically had to perform initial reconnaissance in the middle of a formal operation — not exactly ideal conditions for an error-free mission!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Affirmative, General! Next time, I'll procure the most detailed map available and make sure you have it at your disposal from mission outset! Over and out!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: You can drop the formalities, Kirara. I don't expect you to report back to me like I'm your commanding officer. We hired you as a consultant. It wouldn't be fair to treat you like one of my soldiers.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hey now, it's not like this is some one-sided partnership. We agreed, right? In exchange for my services, you'll help promote our business to the people of Watatsumi Island. Your good word will be integral in helping the Komaniya Express become people's first choice for all their delivery needs!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Our future business is counting on you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Back to Paimon's question, though. You still haven't told us what you're doing in Mondstadt. You mentioned something about a mission?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Ah yes... It's a funny story actually.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Recently, Watatsumi Island has been looking for ways to increase transportation efficiency. Basically, this means improving the operations of our cargo ships. So, we decided to send teams across Teyvat to learn about the most advanced techniques different nations have to offer.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: We had just wrapped up our trip to Liyue when we heard word of your mysterious potion shop. So, we decided to postpone our return journey for a bit and come check it out.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Turns out it was the right choice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon's gotta say, you've practically hit the jackpot by coming here! We've got stuff you can't find anywhere else!

choices.text: We'll make you something super special!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh? More customers from abroad? Hehe, my cuties sure are popular. You really do have friends all over Teyvat...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hm, looking at your two friends here... I can't help but be reminded of my dear little wolf cub... You know what? I should introduce you some time. For some reason, I have a feeling the three of you would really hit it off...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: In fact, once you've wrapped up your potion purchasing, why don't you both join me and my cuties for afternoon tea? I'll even bring my student along.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Afternoon tea? Sounds great! I could really use some refreshments. Long days of deliveries always leave me parched. Thanks for the invitation!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Uh, something tells me you're not going to take no for an answer, hehe... Wait, why does this feel so familiar...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: #Uh, anyway... {NICKNAME}, care to make some introductions?

choices.text: This is the guardian mage of tomes and spells!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: G—Guardian mage? Wow, what an impressive title... Is it a position similar to that of a Guuji?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Or, wait... Could it be that I'm in the presence of someone as high-ranking as Her Excellency, like Lady Sangonomiya herself!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Honestly, {NICKNAME}... You're gonna give the guy a heart attack.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be nervous, Gorou. That's just, uh... a nickname! Her real name is Lisa. She's works as a librarian here in Mondstadt. And, she's also the person in charge of our shop!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lisa, this is Gorou. He's a suuuper powerful general from Watatsumi Island. And this is Kirara. She's a suuuper punctual delivery woman with the Komaniya Express.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Kirara... Hmm, the name sounds familiar. Ah, the collection of books from Inazuma that I have in the library... You were the one who delivered them, yes? What a helpful little gem, you are!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, I'm glad our paths have crossed again, Miss Lisa. I hope you'll consider me for future delivery jobs as well!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As for my cuties' other acquaintance... I believe I've read a few articles about you, General Gorou. I seem to recall more than a few references to your empathetic nature and skillful approach to leading your troops.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Let me guess... Your troops are also the focus of your potion inquiry here today?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Commercial activity between Watatsumi Island and other regions has been on the rise recently. The workload has increased so much, both the soldiers who work on our shipping convoys and the sailors who work on the merchant vessels are struggling to keep up.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: What would really come in handy would be a potion that could help them handle their intense workload. Like one that could enhance their energy and physical strength.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Okay, I could definitely use a potion like that as well!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: When I'm out on a long delivery, you wouldn't believe how tired my legs would get from trekking across all that rugged terrain — not to mention the damage it does to my paws.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: My cuties should be more than familiar with that kind of potion by now. I'm sure they'll have it done in no time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, leave it to us!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, while you two hop to it, I'm going to find an idle knight to deliver a letter to my little wolf cub, and ask him to treat us to the pleasure of his company.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Once my cuties are done brewing a potion that satisfies your needs, we'll all celebrate over afternoon tea!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, afternoon tea on the banks of Cider Lake... Wonder what that'll be like? I can't wait to find out!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Phew, I'm just glad I've finally found a way to help my troops...

choices.text: She also makes a mean cup of tea!
We'll make sure you leave with something fun and useful!
